crossRefs.note: For, “His letters”, they say, “are weighty and strong, but his bodily presence is weak, and his speech is despised.”
Therefore judge nothing before the time, until the Lord comes, who will both bring to light the hidden things of…
But I will come to you shortly, if the Lord is willing. And I will know, not the word of those who are puffed up, but…

translations.web: that I may not seem as if I desire to terrify you by my letters.
translations.bsb: I do not want to seem to be trying to frighten you by my letters.
translations.kjv: That ➔ I may ➔ not seem as if I would terrify you by letters.
translations.asv: that I may not seem as if I would terrify you by my letters.
